subject: Novamed executive recap and procurement path — outcomes & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Novamed discovery — exec sponsor recap & next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for carving out time today with the Novamed leadership team. Quick recap of what we heard on the exec call and proposed next steps so everyone has the same record:

Key business outcomes you emphasized:
- Reduce time-to-insight for clinical analytics pipelines by ~40% to accelerate retrospective studies.
- Avoid vendor lock-in: ability to run inference across hosted and on-prem for PHI workloads.
- Contain monthly inference spend within current budget envelope (goal: sub-50% increase vs baseline).

Primary risks / concerns called out by the sponsor (Dr. Moretti):
- Data residency & auditability for regulated trials.
- SOC 2 / ISO evidence and alignment with existing vendor controls.
- Procurement timeline: legal needs a 3–4 week review for master services agreement + SOW.

What we committed to do next:
1) Share a focused security packet (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram) by end of day tomorrow — attaching the high-level SOC2 overview and stakeholder map draft.
2) Provide an estimated procurement timeline and a proposal SOW draft for a sandbox + pilot (30–60 days).
3) Schedule a short technical runbook review with Novamed infra team (Thomas?) — please confirm availability next week.

Proposed immediate dates:
- Technical hookup (30–45m): Wed Jan 24 or Thu Jan 25 (any morning CET preferred)
- Exec recap meeting (internal sponsor + Redwood): week of Jan 29 for formal procurement alignment

If that looks right, I’ll send a calendar invite and the security packet. Appreciate any additional names we should loop into procurement/legal to expedite review.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0191
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference\nAttachments: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf, novamed-stakeholder-map.xlsx

From: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Thomas Green <t.green@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 12:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Novamed discovery — exec sponsor recap & next steps

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. This aligns closely with what we discussed. A few clarifications and asks from our side:

1) Procurement path: legal (me + Thomas) will run the vendor security review. If you can send the SOC2/ISO evidence and the proposed SOW it will help us kick off the internal review and raise an initial PR.
2) Data residency: the pilot must keep PHI inside our EU VPC; we will need an architecture diagram showing where keys are managed and how audit logs are surfaced.
3) Timeline constraint: our Q1 deliverable to the board needs a signed pilot by Feb 28. That means legal needs the SOW and any standard terms this week to keep the timeline.

I can do the technical hookup with Thomas on Thu Jan 25 at 09:30 CET. Please confirm and include any runbook notes.

Best,
Elena Rossi
VP Digital Transformation | Novamed Health
elena@novamed.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Thomas Green <t.green@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 08:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Novamed discovery — exec sponsor recap & next steps

Elena — solid, and understood on the Feb 28 pilot target. Next steps on our side (action ownership included):

- Security packet (Karthik): attaching the high-level SOC2 summary and an 1-page data flow diagram for the EU VPC pattern. Full evidence pack available on request (we can arrange an encrypted share).
- Draft SOW + pilot plan (Laura): attached a short SOW draft that outlines a 6-week sandbox + 4-week pilot, acceptance criteria, and costs. Laura will follow with a version that includes a compliance addendum.
- Technical hookup (Marissa coordinating): we’ll run a 30–45m session on Thu Jan 25 09:30 CET — invite sent. Team for that call: Thomas (Novamed infra), Laura (Redwood solutions), and our infra engineer (internal notes).

Risk mitigations we propose:
- Data residency: pilot runs in Novamed’s EU VPC with customer-managed KMS; logs forwarded to your audit pipeline.
- SLA/rollback: include a fallback to a locally pinned model variant and a pre-agreed rollback window in the SOW.
- Legal cadence: we can accept a standard vendor addendum and provide a redline-friendly SOW to reduce back-and-forth.

Attachments in this message: redwood-soc2-overview.pdf, proposed-sow-draft.docx, novamed-stakeholder-map.xlsx

Let me know if you want any language changes before Laura sends the next SOW iteration to procurement.

Thanks — see you on Thursday,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick internal note and ask:

Elena/Thomas — appreciate confirming the 25th slot. From Redwood leadership: I’ll join the Jan 25 technical hookup to ensure the SOW aligns to the board timeline. Laura — please prioritize a redline-ready SOW so legal can review over the weekend. Karthik — can you escalate to our legal ops to prepare a standard vendor addendum so Novamed legal has a short list of acceptable term positions?

I’ll also prepare an executive one-pager highlighting the 40% time-to-insight target and the rollback/SLR controls for Dr. Moretti’s review. If we keep the SOW redline cycle to 7 business days we should be on track for Feb 28.
